docs_overview.description: Overview of the documentation: source and commit, language, page count, folders, and every metadata field with its values and page counts. Call it to learn which filters exist.

get_section.description: Look up a section by its heading anchor or ID across all pages, for example a rule number such as 'RS-203'.

params.anchor: The anchor or ID, e.g. 'rs-203'. Case-insensitive.

list_docs.description: List pages with their path, title, url and metadata, optionally narrowed by path prefix and metadata filters.

params.path_prefix: Only pages whose path starts with this, e.g. 'python/'.
params.filters: Metadata filters: field name to a value or a list of values (any of them matches). docs_overview lists the fields and their values.

read_doc.description: Read a page as Markdown, with its metadata in a header. Pass section (an anchor or heading text) to read just that section and its subsections.

params.path: Page path as returned by search_docs or list_docs, e.g. 'rust/rules.mdx'. The extension may be left out.

search_docs.description: Full-text search over every section of every page. Use a few distinctive keywords in the language of the documentation, whatever language the user writes in, rather than a full sentence. Returns the best-matching sections with path, heading, anchor, url and a snippet; follow up with read_doc(path, section=anchor) for the full text.

params.query: Keywords to search for, in the language of the documentation. Add spelling variants, synonyms and English terms freely: keywords that do not occur are ignored. Case-insensitive; words of 3+ letters also match longer words that start with them, and words of 6+ letters also match spellings one letter off.

### RS-201: clippy pedantic, åtvaringar avviste i CI

MÅ Applikasjon

Clippy si `pedantic`-gruppe **MÅ** vere på, og CI **MÅ** køyre clippy med
`-D warnings`. Typen `Vec<T>` står i kode og skal stå urørt.

```toml
[workspace.lints.clippy]
pedantic = { level = "warn", priority = -1 }
```

### RS-203: Ingen unwrap i produksjonskode

MÅ IKKJE

Produksjonskode **MÅ IKKJE** kalle `unwrap()`. Bruk `?` og ein feiltype.

  **Linux**
    Køyr `cargo clippy` i terminalen.

  **Windows**
    Køyr `cargo clippy` i PowerShell.

```rust
import_this_is_not_an_import();
export fn also_not_removed() {}
let v: Vec<String> = Vec::new(); // <Badges> inni kode står att
```

:::kvifor[Kvifor ikkje unwrap?]
Ein panikk i produksjon tek ned heile tenesta.
:::

eigarforum: rustforum
tema: testing
teknologi: Rust
---

Testar er ein del av koden, ikkje eit tillegg.

## Einingstestar

Einingstestar ligg i same fil som koden, i ein `tests`-modul.

### Eksempel

```rust
#[test]
fn adds() { assert_eq!(2 + 2, 4); }
```

## Integrasjonstestar

Integrasjonstestar ligg i `tests/`-mappa og brukar berre det offentlege API-et.

### Eksempel

Sjå `tests/api.rs` i malprosjektet.

## Sjå [regelen](rules.mdx#rs-203) om unwrap

Testkode kan bruke `unwrap()` fritt.

## Fixtures ##

Delte testdata ligg i `tests/fixtures/`.
